messages:
Priya Reddy: quick one — thinking about moving the admit pipeline to a capability-first fast probe step before we run full benches. saves cost but may miss ABI/serialization issues. thoughts?
Alex Chen: capability-first = run tiny end-to-end prompts to validate behavior, right? cost-wise sounds good. when would we catch schema/onnx mismatch?
Priya Reddy: yeah — idea is tiny probes for semantics + a very fast metadata/manifest lint. so two phases: lint (cheap) -> probes (cheap, behavior) -> full bench (expensive).
Marco Diaz: tradeoff: probes catch quality regressions but not file-format incompatibilities. need a strict handshake for loader/ABI acceptance earlier. I'm worried about silent fail modes.
Zoe Park: we can hybridize. quick lint ensures loader+ops compat, probes validate response surface. probe harness must be standardized so results are comparable across models/quant variations.
Priya Reddy: agreeing. proposal for a "probe-spec" that teams implement; small, deterministic payloads. sample config idea: 
```json
{"name":"basic-fill","seq_len":16,"inputs":["The capital of France is"],"expected_regex":"Paris","max_tokens":4}
```
Marco Diaz: also include runtime knobs in spec: concurrency, kv_cache_warmup, quant_tag so we exercise the same runtime path.
Priya Reddy: good call. where do we store golden outputs? artifact registry keyed by model-fingerprint+quant+probe-id?
Alex Chen: yes. rwi-model-goldens bucket + ACLs. TTL policy? old models could be pruned after N months. privacy: probes must not contain customer data — keep corp-owned prompts.
infra-bot: created bucket rwi-model-goldens in us-west-2 (policy: private, lifecycle 180d).
Zoe Park: define acceptance signals: quality delta vs golden (token-level edit distance / fuzzy match), and perf deltas (p95 latency, memory). sample policy: quality_delta <= 0.5% OR fuzzy_score >= 0.98; perf_p95_change <= 5%.
Priya Reddy: can we make those thresholds configurable per model-class? e.g., vision vs small-chat have different tolerances. config should live with model metadata.
Ella Thompson: operational constraints: require the lint + probes to pass before we allow canary rollout. canary rule example: if probe_quality_drop > configured_threshold -> block rollout and notify on-call.
Zoe Park: snippet for rollout guard: 
```yaml
rollout_guards:
  - name: probe-quality
    metric: probe_quality_delta
    threshold: 0.5
    action: rollback
```
Marco Diaz: also add an "audit-mode" that records failing probes but doesn't block, for new model families during first 2 weeks. helps calibrate thresholds.
Priya Reddy: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with probe-spec, artifact key schema, and rollout guard syntax. volunteers for review? @Alex @Zoe
Alex Chen: I can review the probe-spec and help design the perf probes.
Zoe Park: I'll take the rollout guard + canary integration bits.
Ella Thompson: allocate 2 sprint points from infra runway to implement artifact bucket hooks + basic probe runner.
Priya Reddy: awesome — tagging follow-up RFC in #eng-ml-rfcs. thanks all :thumbsup:
